system.description:
Battle Amp

While in this state, you gain the following benefits;

Your Unarmed Damage die increase in size by 1 step to a max of d12.

You have a rank of Mastery on Strength based skill and ability checks.

While standing on the ground, you have advantage on checks and saves to resist being moved, knocked prone, grappled, restrained or Exhausted.
system.summary: Unarmed die up one step and Mastery on Strength checks. Advantage to resist being moved, knocked prone, grappled, restrained or Exhausted while on the ground.

rules.text: Start: Bonus action, 2 Calories and an Akimichi food pill. Lasts 1 minute, then 10 minutes to recover before reuse.
While standing on the ground: advantage on checks and saves to resist being moved, knocked prone, grappled, restrained or Exhausted.
